summary: Iter 21 — PRODUCTION (https://auremcto.com) FOUNDER end-to-end frontend test on the dogfood repo polarisbuiltinc-wq/auremdev. Login + repo selection + LOOP toggle + PLAN card all PASS. Several iter 212m-109 fixes appear NOT LIVE on prod — strongly indicates PRE-DEPLOY state (prod has NOT been redeployed since iter 212m-109). Findings: (1) Auth login → /dashboard, localStorage.aurem_token + aurem_user populated PASS. /api/aurem-dev/auth/me returns 200 tier=founder is_admin=true is_unlimited=true 2 repos connected PASS. (2) Clicking 'polarisbuiltinc-wq/auremdev' in sidebar updates localStorage.aurem_active_project='p_55aa60c68d' and topbar breadcrumb shows 'polarisbuiltinc-wq/auremdev@main' PASS — but on reload the breadcrumb resets to the user's most-recent server-side active project (TJSNDHU/Aurem) even though localStorage still holds the polaris id → frontend ignores aurem_active_project at hydration. (3) PROMPT MODE: send button click works and a reply renders. BUT reply for both prompts ('list 3 files from this repo' AND 'show me the first 10 lines of README.md from this repo') is **'No repo is connected right now, so I can't pull up README.md'** — even though a project IS connected with github_url=https://github.com/polarisbuiltinc-wq/auremdev.git. This is the user's #1 functional complaint and reproduces on the dogfood account. The LLM is not receiving repo context. (4) LOOP toggle OFF→ON flips localStorage.ora_execution_mode='loop', pill turns chunky orange 'LOOP ON' PASS. (5) LOOP send → PLAN phase: PlanApprovalCard renders within ~25s with bullet list, target file README.md, 'Approve & Run' + 'Cancel loop' buttons PASS. LoopStepBar shows PLAN orange + EXECUTE/VERIFY/SCAN/SHIP dimmed PASS. Plan content is generic boilerplate ('Open README.md / Insert / Save') — no evidence the LLM inspected the actual repo. (6) DID NOT click Approve — strong risk that EXECUTE phase would either fail (since LLM has no repo context above) or emit synthetic content and no real commit; logged as needs-retest after redeploy. (7) PROTOCOL LEAK REGRESSION (P0): chat-messages still renders '[Working on project: dogfood — repo polarisbuiltinc-wq/auremdev@main]' markers AND 'aurem-handoff' fenced blocks in user-visible bubbles. iter 212m-105/106 sanitizer fix that strips 16 protocol labels is NOT effective on prod. (8) TOPBAR AUTO-HIDE P0 STILL UNFIXED: [data-testid='chat-messages'] scrollHeight=808 clientHeight=808 isScrollable=false — programmatic scrollTo(0,1500) yields scrollTop=0, topbar height stays 87px with transform=matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0). The minHeight:0 fix on chat-panel + chat-messages claimed in iter 212m-109 is NOT live on prod. (9) F12 console error badge appeared in session 1 ('1 console error — send to ORA') and was auto-fired multiple times producing chat-flood: at least 6 '[Working on project: dogfood — repo …]\n\nF12 errors captured (0 console, X network). Please diagnose.' messages were sent without any window.confirm dialog appearing — iter 212m-109 confirm-gate IS NOT LIVE on prod. (10) Network 520 (Cloudflare 'Web server returning unknown error') burst hit /api/health, /aurem-dev/cto/projects/list, /aurem-dev/chat/stream, /aurem-dev/founder-offer/*, /aurem-dev/thinking-hint during session 1 (~5s window); recovered in session 2 (all endpoints 200). The frontend chat panel rendered the RAW Cloudflare HTML error page as an assistant bubble — that's a P1 frontend resilience bug. (11) /api/aurem-dev/codebase-health/last?project_id=p_55aa60c68d returns 404 — same legacy probe from iter 19/20, still present. OVERALL VERDICT: PROD HAS NOT BEEN REDEPLOYED with iter 212m-109. All 4 critical fixes (real loop EXECUTE via LLM, history 100, F12 confirm-gate, send button type=button) appear absent. Action: main agent must verify prod redeploy.
